name: CreateThreeEntryBlend
evidence: clears the words at 0x0 and 0xC of a three-entry blend record (12-byte entries), sets the third's to 1.0, builds the blend with func_00139038 (stride 12, count 3) and applies the record with func_001399F8, returning the blend; StartPlayer calls it

name: SolvePlayerLinkSystem
evidence: original assembly: builds a symmetric system from func_001BA2E8, func_001B8FE8 and func_001BC7F8 and solves it (FactorSymmetricMatrix, SolveFactoredSystem); only PlacePlayerOnLinkedObject calls it

name: PlacePlayerOnLinkedObject
evidence: original assembly: reads the world position and rotation of the object at 0x2204 (GetObjectWorldPosition, GetObjectWorldRotation) and places the player against it by the sub-state at 0x2228, through SolvePlayerLinkSystem; SetPlayerState and ControlPlayerOnLinkedObject call it

name: TurnPlayerTowardLinkedObject
evidence: original assembly: sets the target at 0x22B0 (func_001B9AB0), builds the rotation from the player's position (+0x140) to the object at 0x2204 and its heading at 0x638, and steers to it with func_001B9D10; StepPlayer calls it

name: SyncPlayerTarget
evidence: slot 51 of class 0x07: passes the vectors at 0x22D0 and 0x22E0 to func_001B9AB0 and func_001B9AC8 of the object at 0x22AC (StepCollider calls slot 51 of each owner)

name: ControlPlayerOnLinkedObject
evidence: original assembly: compares the stick's heading through the camera (func_00144FF8, g_camera) with the player's heading at 0x638 and the object at 0x2204's (GetLinkedObjectHeading), moves between the sub-states 0x32 to 0x35 with SetPlayerState and re-places the player (PlacePlayerOnLinkedObject); ControlPlayer calls it

name: ReleaseFarPlayerLinks
evidence: original assembly: clears the link at 0x2210 (and the word at 0x4B8) when its point is more than 50 units from the partner's (+0x23D4) position, and the link at 0x2214 when the partner's position in its frame lies beyond 2500; UpdatePlayer and SetPlayerState call it

name: SetFlaggedLinkContactMask
evidence: finds the first node of the list whose item has flag bit 2 and, when it is attached (IsObjectAttached), sets or clears contact flag 0x40 between the two objects (SetContactPairFlags) by the flag argument; then clears +0x4B8; SetPlayerState calls it

name: AddPlayerObjectContacts
evidence: original assembly: when the object is not attached (IsObjectAttached) sets the player's state to (2, 2); otherwise builds a basis (BuildBasisFromXAndZHint) and creates three contacts with it (CreatePooledContact, kinds 0xB, 0xB and 0xA); ReleasePlayerContacts calls it

name: GetLinkedObjectHeading
evidence: converts the direction at +0x50 of the object at 0x2204 into world space (func_001280C0 on its frame at +0x18) and stores its heading (ArctangentOfRatio) in the output

name: ComputePlayerLinkPose
evidence: original assembly: converts positions of the object at 0x2204 and the partner (+0x23D4) through the frame at +0x61C (func_00128018) and builds two axis-angle rotations (func_00189D38, BuildAxisAngleMatrix); SetPlayerState and UpdatePlayerLinkPose call it

name: UpdatePlayerLinkPose
evidence: original assembly: runs ComputePlayerLinkPose, eases the vector at 0x22F0 toward it (func_001EA818, func_001EA918 with D_00274DE0 and D_00274DF0) and applies the pose sources at 0x251C and 0x2520 (ApplyPoseSource); DrawPlayer calls it

name: GetPlayerPose
evidence: slot 35 of class 0x07: in state 3 returns the placed-object pose func_001225D0, otherwise the character pose func_001C5DB8 (a rotation about the heading at 0x638 into the output)
